card.name: Heshbon
card.desc: Old Testament — Heshbon is named as the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, in Numbers and Joshua, and the Song of Solomon uses its pools in a poetic comparison. One place, not drawn: no position is given for the city, its pools or its gate.

card.name: Psalm 85 and the Book of Mormon (heading)
card.desc: Old Testament — The Church edition’s heading to Psalm 85 relates truth springing out of the earth to the Book of Mormon. This is the edition’s interpretation; verse 11 does not name that book.
